title: BunkPro — Logout with local wipe + leaderboard removal + Internet Identity sign-out

requirements.summary: Add a Settings-screen Log out button with confirmation that deletes leaderboard data (when possible) and wipes all local app persistence before returning to the Login flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings displays a clearly labeled button: "Log out".
Pressing "Log out" opens a confirmation step with clear English copy explaining deletion impact (local data will be erased and leaderboard data will be deleted).

On confirm, the app calls the new backend delete endpoint when a backend actor is available; failure to reach the backend is shown as a clear English error and the app does not claim the leaderboard deletion succeeded.

On confirm, the app clears local app persistence by clearing IndexedDB (via the existing IndexedDB client) and resets in-memory state using the existing reducer action `RESET_ALL` so `state.userProfile` becomes null.
On confirm, the app clears any locally cached ranking data (e.g., the `rankCache` localStorage cache) so stale leaderboard data is not shown after logout.
After local erase completes, the UI returns to the Login flow (login gate is shown because `state.userProfile` is null).

file_operations.description: Create a Settings "Log out" (destructive) UI section that uses the existing ConfirmDestructiveDialog (shadcn/ui AlertDialog wrapper) to present an English confirmation describing both local wipe and leaderboard deletion; on confirm it triggers the logout flow (backend deletion attempt + local wipes) and shows English success/error toasts. Use shadcn-ui Card/Button primitives for consistent styling. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the new LogoutCard into the Settings screen so a clearly labeled "Log out" button is visible; connect it to the existing app store dispatch (RESET_ALL), IndexedDB clearing via the existing indexedDbClient, and ranking cache clearing via rankCache; call the backend delete capability via the existing actor (deleteCallerUser) only when appropriate, and show clear English error messages without stack traces. Use existing shadcn-ui layout components already used on this page. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Ensure the local wipe path can reliably clear persisted app state by using the existing IndexedDB clear functionality (clearIndexedDB) and keeping the API stable for the Settings logout flow.
Ensure the logout flow can fully remove cached leaderboard data by using/confirming a single clear function (clearRankingCache) that removes the localStorage ranking cache key used by RankingService.

Adjust persistence behavior to avoid re-saving user data immediately after a logout reset (RESET_ALL) so the IndexedDB clear performed during logout is not immediately repopulated with prior state; keep login gating behavior intact (LoginPage shown when state.userProfile is null).

requirements.summary: Extend the logout flow to also clear Internet Identity session so subsequent interactions are unauthenticated until login.
acceptanceCriteria: The logout flow calls Internet Identity clear/logout using the existing `useInternetIdentity().clear()` API (without modifying any immutable files).
After logout, backend actor calls requiring authentication are no longer possible until the user logs in again via Internet Identity (where applicable).
User-facing error/success messages during logout are in English and do not show raw stack traces.

file_operations.description: Invoke Internet Identity logout via the existing useInternetIdentity().clear() as part of the confirmed logout sequence, ensuring the app returns to the login gate (state.userProfile becomes null) and user-facing messaging remains English and sanitized. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Validate that the clear() behavior supports the Settings logout flow (clears identity state and stored auth state cleanly) and that errors are surfaced as safe, English messages to the UI without exposing raw stack traces.
